summary: Frontend-only verification of the 419 PAGE EXPIRED fix. Three fresh browser contexts tested: (1) admin@test.com on user host modern-stack-app-8 -> landed on /admin/dashboard, login POST went to https://modern-stack-app-8.../login (same-origin), no 419, no console errors, no failed responses; (2) seller@test.com on user host -> /seller/dashboard, no 419; (3) admin@test.com on canonical host 1431a1a0-... -> /admin/dashboard, no 419 (no regression). Session persistence verified on user host: /admin/users and /admin/categories both rendered without 419 and without redirect to /login. Asset origin verified: all CSS/JS script+link tags resolve to modern-stack-app-8 host, zero canonical-host (1431a1a0) leakage, all 200, pages render correctly (no white screen / module load errors).

issues: Two auction thumbnails return HTTP 403 (broken images): /storage/auctions/a1.jpg and /storage/auctions/a7.jpg. Root cause: storage/app/public/auctions directory does not exist while seeded auctions reference those filenames (public/storage symlink is fine). Cosmetic/seed-data issue, not auth related.

action_items: Optional (minor): add missing seeded auction images under storage/app/public/auctions (a1.jpg, a7.jpg) or point seeder to existing placeholder image to remove 403 console errors on /seller/dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: AppServiceProvider now only calls URL::forceScheme('https') and relies on trustProxies(at: '*') for the host - correct for multi-host preview; APP_URL remaining canonical is harmless for URL generation but is still used for CLI/queue-generated links (e.g. mail verification URLs will point to canonical host). Acceptable, but note it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 419 fix confirmed working on both user host (modern-stack-app-8) and canonical host. Login POST is same-origin on both. Note: Playwright/Chromium hides the 'Cookie' header from request.headers, so cookie presence was inferred from successful authenticated redirect to the role dashboard rather than raw header inspection. LiveKit already validated in iteration_3. Only remaining known cosmetic issue: 403 on /storage/auctions/a1.jpg and a7.jpg.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 419 was caused by URL::forceRootUrl(config('app.url')) pinning all generated URLs (incl. Ziggy base) to the canonical host, making the login POST cross-origin from the user's preview host so the session/XSRF cookie was not sent. Removal of forceRootUrl + trustProxies('*') makes all URLs derive from the forwarded Host, restoring same-origin POSTs. Verified fixed.
